build_mask_point_head: build a MaskPointHead module with configurable FC layers and class-agnostic mask prediction for PointRend
forward_mask_classification: run forward pass to classify points using fine-grained and coarse features concatenated through FC layers
get_training_targets: get training targets for MaskPointHead by sampling ground truth masks at relative ROI point coordinates
calculate_point_loss: calculate cross-entropy loss for point predictions against ground truth targets with class labels
sample_uncertain_points_train: sample most uncertain points during training using importance sampling and random sampling ratios
